subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: Should the iOS owners require signed-device OSStatus evidence before approving any change to gateway-token Keychain attributes, entitlements, or fallback behavior?
rationale: The failure blocks onboarding at a credential boundary, but the current Boolean API hides the native cause; automation cannot safely choose a storage-policy change without owner-confirmed device evidence.

options.title: Diagnose before changing storage
options.body: Add or use redacted OSStatus diagnostics, reproduce on a signed fresh-device installation, and approve the narrow storage repair only after identifying the native failure.

options.title: Change Keychain semantics immediately
options.body: Modify accessibility, query, or retry behavior without the failing OSStatus, accepting a higher risk of treating the wrong cause or weakening the security boundary.

recommendation.title: Diagnose before changing storage
recommendation.body: Add or use redacted OSStatus diagnostics, reproduce on a signed fresh-device installation, and approve the narrow storage repair only after identifying the native failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor guide assigns this person to the iOS app and the issue timeline already routes this report to them.
